edit.text.note: Translated from printcraft 8f16855 (crates/edit/src/added.rs and added/{types,layout,draw,store}.rs, ui-egui tools/content_ui.rs and commands.rs:534) into core/folio/lib/added.mjs. An added text is its own content stream tagged /PCMark /Added with its parameters in /PCAdded, in a standard family (Helvetica, Times, Courier), size 1 to 500, colour, alignment, bold, italic and character spacing; a click puts a 200 point box with its top left at the click, a drag draws one. NOT translated: text shaped with the craft-fonts faces (Arabic, Hebrew, Thai: refused with the standard-fonts message), per-paragraph alignments (aligns), pasting and isolate_content. Line spacing, horizontal scale and underline are not offered for added text (upstream shows them disabled for it too). Not checked against upstream beyond what is listed: the exact look of the box while it is open.

edit.image.note: AddImage (run.rs): a PNG or JPEG picked in the system Open dialog, centred and never enlarged beyond 80 % of the page when no box is given. Added pictures are items of their own (AddedImage): move, resize by the corners (proportions kept), turn, flip, crop (up to 47.5 % from each side) and replace go through edit.added_change. Pictures other than PNG and JPEG (upstream also reads other formats it can decode) are refused.

edit.added.note: list_added, for the surface: the page's added text and pictures with their boxes in page view points.

edit.added_select.note: Selects an added item so Format text and the Image controls act on it.

edit.added_change.note: Edit::UpdateContent, DeleteContent and ReplaceImage: retype, format, move, resize, turn, flip, crop, replace or delete an added item; an emptied text is deleted (content_ui.rs finish). A turned picture's box swaps its sides about its centre so the picture is not stretched (not checked against content_ui.rs).

edit.link.note: Link tool (link_ui.rs, annot/links.rs AddLink): a drag draws the rectangle (at least 4 px each way) and opens Link Properties; the link is a Link annotation with a /URI action and its border and highlight. Existing links show outlines in the tool, a click selects one and Delete removes it. NOT translated: a link that goes to a page of the document and the double-click edit of an existing link in the window (edit.link_change takes the new address, rectangle and look); not checked against upstream: the outline colours.

edit.links.note: The links of a page for the Link tool: address, box.

edit.attach.note: Edit::AddAttachment (organize/attachments.rs add_attachment): a document-level attachment in /Names /EmbeddedFiles under the file name (made unique with " (2)"), with /Size, /ModDate and the type when the name says one. There is no Attachments panel in this app yet (the rail toggle stays pending); edit.attachments lists them.

edit.attachments.note: attachment_keys with size, type and description, until the Attachments panel exists.

dialog.link-properties.title: Link Properties
dialog.link-properties.note: printcraft link_ui.rs LinkDraft: the link action (open a web page, or go to a page of this document) and its look. The page link names the model page, which writing the file turns into the page object (model/pdf-write.mjs); a link with another action is kept as it is. Go to a page view with a zoom is not offered: the destination is the whole page (Fit).

edit.header.edit-text-images.note: Hidden: upstream puts Edit text & images on the floating toolbar, on from the moment Edit opens (edit.rs); the panel header is only the title, Preferences and Close. The toolbar button (quick.bar.edit-text) runs edit.edit_text.
